title: Italian Game: developing the pieces
introduction: The Italian Game begins with both players contesting the center. This short line shows the first moves and a common way to develop the bishop; it is not a forced sequence.

moves.explanation: White occupies the center with a pawn and opens lines for the queen and bishop.
Black answers in the center and opens lines for the queen and bishop.
The knight develops toward the center and attacks the e5 pawn.
Black develops a knight and protects the pawn on e5.
The bishop develops to c4, looking toward the f7 pawn. Both sides still need to develop their remaining pieces and keep their kings safe.
